services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: The Oceanic Marina, originally established in 1927 as Pauel's Boats, had been owned and operated by Peter Pawlikowski since 1991. After Pete's passing in 2018, his wife Barbara Pawlikowski, has been owner and operator. Ed Grant joined the Oceanic team in 2020 as the marina yard manager and head mechanic. He has over 25 years experience in the marina industry. The 100 slip floating dock marina accommodates vessels up to 50' and has 18 waverunner slips. Water and 30 to 50 amp electric service is available on all docks. There is a fully stocked marine store, 20 ton travel lift and 24 hour video surveillance. Oceanic Marina is open to the public and offers skiff, pontoon, kayak and stand up

blurb: Oceanic Marina is a full service marina with 100 floating dock slips for vessels up to 50 feet and 18 waverunner slips. They offer rentals of skiffs, pontoons, single and double kayaks, and stand up paddle boards. The marina has shore power, water, a marine store, and a 20 ton travel lift, with fast access to Sandy Hook Bay and the Atlantic Ocean.
